name: Social short
description: A 15 to 45 second vertical short for social feeds: one hook, one idea, one call to action. Brief, a style frame, the final.

steps.name: Hook frames
steps.describe: The on-screen script plus two or three stills: the hook (first second), the middle, the CTA card.

checks.title: Every word, name and number is right
checks.how: Read every on-screen word against the brief. Names, numbers and spelling exactly right.

checks.title: The hook lands in the first second
checks.how: Frame 0 already shows the hook's subject or words: no logo intro, no blank or slow fade-in.

checks.title: Clear of the platform's buttons
checks.how: For 9:16, no text in the top 12%, the bottom 20% or the right 15% (captions, buttons, profile). Check on the stills and sampled frames.

checks.title: Text is readable on a phone
checks.how: Text at least 4% of frame height, 4.5:1 contrast, on screen long enough to read twice (words / 3 + 1 seconds).

checks.title: Works with the sound off
checks.how: Every spoken idea is also on screen (captions or titles): watch the frame sheet without audio and the message still lands.

checks.title: Every second looked at
checks.how: qc.mjs passes (no black, flash or frozen frames unless designed) and you looked at its sheet.

checks.title: The right size, rate and length
checks.how: qc.mjs: the brief's shape at 1080 wide or more, constant 30 fps, H.264 + AAC, duration within 5%.

checks.title: Loudness and no clipping
checks.how: qc.mjs: -14 LUFS ±1, true peak ≤ -1 dBTP, nothing distorted when you listen.
